name: Government Medical College, Manjeri
tagline: Malappuram’s government tertiary teaching hospital and referral centre
summary: Government Medical College, Manjeri (GMC Manjeri) is a state-run tertiary teaching hospital in Malappuram (est. 2013) offering 24×7 emergency care, MBBS/PG training and expanding inpatient and…
description: Government Medical College, Manjeri (GMC Manjeri) is a government-controlled medical college and tertiary referral hospital in the town of Manjeri, Malappuram district. The college was established in 2013 and is affiliated to Kerala University of Health Sciences.

GMC Manjeri functions as the principal public medical centre for Kerala’s most populous district, providing emergency and specialty services to a catchment of several million people. The associated hospital campus includes a large bed strength (reported as around 520 beds) and multiple operation theatres.

The institution combines clinical services with medical education: an annual MBBS intake (reported as 110) and selected postgraduate programmes (ENT, Ophthalmology, Dermatology) after NMC recognition. Emergency departments and core clinical services run 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

The college and hospital are under active development: recent government approvals and project funding cover a critical care block, diagnostic upgrades and campus works to increase capacity and teaching infrastructure.
highlights: Established as a government medical college in 2013; affiliated to KUHS
Tertiary referral hospital for Malappuram district with ~500–520 beds
Undergraduate intake (MBBS) and recognised PG seats in selected specialties
Ongoing infrastructure expansion (critical care block, CT, viral R&D lab)

sections.heading: Background
body: GMC Manjeri began as an upgrade of the Manjeri General Hospital and was inaugurated in 2013. It is administered by the Directorate of Medical Education, Government of Kerala and serves as the main government medical college in Malappuram district.

sections.heading: Services and teaching
body: The college hospital combines inpatient, outpatient and emergency care with undergraduate and postgraduate medical training. Emergency departments operate 24×7; the college runs MBBS courses and has NMC recognition for selected postgraduate programmes (ENT, Ophthalmology, Dermatology).

sections.heading: Development and facilities
body: The campus occupies a substantial site and includes multiple operation theatres, hostels and staff quarters. Government orders and recent funding have approved a 50‑bed critical care block, a 128‑slice CT, a viral research & diagnostic lab and other campus works to expand capacity and services.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: GMC Manjeri is a working tertiary hospital; visits for patients and relatives are handled through the hospital outpatient and admissions sections. Emergency care is available any time; for routine appointments, admissions or PG admissions follow the college website guidance and published notification dates.
Confirm visiting hours, ward/clinic timing and any required documents before you travel — for academic admissions consult the Office of the Principal and the college’s admission notices.

latest.text: Kerala Health & Family Welfare issued administrative sanction under the Annual Plan 2026‑27 for ‘Development of Medical Colleges’ including Allopathy Medical College, Manjeri (part of state plan to upgrade college infrastructure).
College published official PG admission guidelines for academic year 2026‑27 (physical reporting, fee details and document checklist) dated 29‑10‑2026.
State funding package (₹114.92 crore across projects) allocated substantial works to GMC Manjeri—girls' hostel, staff quarters, internal roads, CT unit, viral research lab and other upgrades.
Government Technical Sanction accorded (G.O. No.2972/2024) for electromechanical works for a 50‑bed critical care hospital block at GMC Manjeri.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Open year‑round; clinical and emergency services operate 24×7.
visitorInfo.howToReach: GMC Manjeri is in central Manjeri town (about 12 km from Malappuram); nearest airport is Calicut/ Kozhikode International Airport (≈22 km) and the nearest major railhead is Kozhikode (≈46 km). Reach by road from Malappuram, Kozhikode or nearby towns; confirm local travel times before you go.
etiquette: For emergencies use the 24×7 emergency department; for routine visits call ahead to confirm clinic/OPD times.
Carry photo ID and all medical documents when visiting for admissions or inpatient care; PG admission notices list exact document checklists.
Language at the hospital is Malayalam and English; be prepared for busy wards — non‑urgent visits are best during weekday OPD hours.
Confirm ward visiting rules and parking/entry points with the hospital before travelling, especially during festival periods or strikes.
